blocks.text:
# to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core and
      # nightly.yml.
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        if: matrix.shard == 0 && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')
        run: >-
          dart test --tags integration --coverage=coverage

blocks.text:
# to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core and
      # nightly.yml.
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        if: matrix.shard == 0 && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')
        run: >-
          dart test --tags integration --coverage=coverage

blocks.text:
# to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core and
      # nightly.yml.
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        if: matrix.shard == 0 && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')
        run: >-
          dart test --tags integration --coverage=coverage

blocks.text:
# to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core and
      # nightly.yml.
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        if: matrix.shard == 0 && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')
        run: >-
          dart test --tags integration --coverage=coverage

blocks.text:
# to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core and
      # nightly.yml.
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)
        if: matrix.shard == 0 && (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')
        run: >-
          dart test --tags integration --coverage=coverage

# Rework — gh-1440 skills discovery freshness (PR #1461)

## Issues/Notes

- **🚨 BLOCKING (CI `CRAP + duplication` / `guards` leg + Quality gate
  aggregate):** this PR grew `_runSkillCommand` from CC ~9 to CC 13; at the
  merged-shard coverage of 75.6% it measured CRAP **15.45 > 12.0** (repo-pinned
  threshold in `crap4dart.yaml`), failing the CRAP ratchet step — the only
  failing step of that job.
- **⚠️ IMPORTANT:** the disabled-skill report existed twice with different word
  order (`skill off is disabled (project)` vs `skill off is (project) disabled`).
- **💡 SUGGESTION:** a rescan that threw latched the *new* fingerprint while
  keeping the old index — every later turn saw `fingerprint == baseline`, so the
  rescan was never retried (I2 weakened).
- **💡 SUGGESTION:** `frontmatterWellFormed` counted an empty/comment-only
  `---` fence as malformed (skip + warning), regressing the pre-gh-1440 tolerant
  behavior.
- The other red check (`factory / teammate`) is the machine loop leg that
  produced the REQUEST_CHANGES review — re-armed automatically once the threads
  are resolved. The `Quality gate` aggregate is reddened by the `guards` leg
  fixed here; job logs for the other legs show green (review reproduction).
- Thread-level replies for all four inline threads are in
  `outputs/review_replies.json`. The two top-level `no-id` comments are the
  review summary (addressed by this response) and the gh-807 verdict record
  ("do not edit or reply").

## Approach

TDD for every change — each new test was run RED against the pre-fix code and
GREEN after:

1. **CRAP fix (split-by-concern, AGENTS.md pattern):** extracted the whole
   `skill == null` resolution block from `_runSkillCommand` into
   `Future<Skill?> _resolveSkillMiss(String name)` (toggled-off report →
   cold-resolve via `_coldResolveSkill` → exact `unknown skill` wording, AC4
   untouched). `_runSkillCommand` is now
   `skill ??= await _resolveSkillMiss(name); if (skill == null) return;`.
2. **Disabled-message dedup:** one `_reportDisabledSkill(Skill)` helper renders
   the report for both the indexed and the cold-resolve path — identical
   `skill <name> is disabled (<scope>) — enable with /skills on <name>` wording.
3. **Rescan retry (suggestion):** `_checkSkillsFreshness` no longer
   pre-assigns `_skillRootsFingerprint`; the baseline updates only on success
   (`_noteSkillScan`'s recompute), a failed rescan keeps the old baseline so
   the next turn retries, and the I5 at-most-one-rescan guarantee is held by an
   explicit `_rescanning` latch instead. New IT-7 test (`_CountingEnv` gains a
   `throwOnReadTextFile` fixture): dying body read mid-rescan → last good index
   + one warning; after healing, the next turn rescans and picks the skill up
   (verified RED pre-fix: never retried).
4. **Frontmatter tolerance (suggestion):** `frontmatterWellFormed` accepts
   `loadYaml == null` (empty/comment-only fence = well-formed "no metadata",
   directory-fallback name + first-body-line description — pre-gh-1440
   behavior). Unclosed fences, unparseable yaml and non-map yaml still skip
   with the warn-once note (AC6/E-1 unchanged). RED tests first in
   `test/utils/frontmatter_parser_test.dart` + a `discoverSkills`-level test in
   `test/skills/skills_test.dart`.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/skill_commands.dart` — `_resolveSkillMiss` + `_reportDisabledSkill`
  helpers; `_runSkillCommand` slimmed; `_checkSkillsFreshness` success-only
  baseline + `_rescanning` latch.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — `_rescanning` field.
- `lib/src/utils/frontmatter_parser.dart` — `frontmatterWellFormed` accepts
  empty/comment-only yaml fences (doc comment updated).
- `test/cli/skills_freshness_cli_test.dart` — IT-7 rescan-retry test;
  `_CountingEnv.throwOnReadTextFile` fixture.
- `test/utils/frontmatter_parser_test.dart` — `frontmatterWellFormed` group
  (7 cases).
- `test/skills/skills_test.dart` — empty-fence discovery test (REG-1 behavior).

## Test Coverage

- `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (per-PR CI suite, with coverage) —
  **10102 passed, 0 failed, 10 skipped** ✅ (standing platform skips:
  macOS `sandbox-exec` live legs + the documented giant-transcript stall skip)
- **CRAP ratchet reproduced locally** with the same input as CI (`crap4dart
  analyze` over merged-suite lcov incl. the jsr delegate trio):
  **Max CRAP: 12.00 — OK**; `_runSkillCommand` **15.45 → 7.31** (CC 13 → 7),
  `_resolveSkillMiss` 5.03, `_checkSkillsFreshness` 7.00 (100% cov),
  `_reportDisabledSkill` 2.00 (100% cov).
- `crap4dart check --baseline` — 3 passed, 1 warned (the pre-existing
  Type-2 duplication soft-warning window; never fails a build) ✅
- `crap4dart check --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc` — PASS ✅
- Diff coverage ratchet: **91.04%** of changed lib lines (min 80) ✅
  (`skill_commands.dart` 97.2%, `frontmatter_parser.dart` 100%)
- PTY suites over the refactored paths: `skills_freshness_pty_test` ✅,

{"content":"# Rework — gh-1440 skills discovery freshness (PR #1461)

## Issues/Notes

- **🚨 BLOCKING (CI `CRAP + duplication` / `guards` leg + Quality gate
  aggregate):** this PR grew `_runSkillCommand` from CC ~9 to CC 13; at the
  merged-shard coverage of 75.6% it measured CRAP **15.45 > 12.0** (repo-pinned
  threshold in `crap4dart.yaml`), failing the CRAP ratchet step — the only
  failing step of that job.
- **⚠️ IMPORTANT:** the disabled-skill report existed twice with different word
  order (`skill off is disabled (project)` vs `skill off is (project) disabled`).
- **💡 SUGGESTION:** a rescan that threw latched the *new* fingerprint while
  keeping the old index — every later turn saw `fingerprint == baseline`, so the
  rescan was never retried (I2 weakened).
- **💡 SUGGESTION:** `frontmatterWellFormed` counted an empty/comment-only
  `---` fence as malformed (skip + warning), regressing the pre-gh-1440 tolerant
  behavior.
- The other red check (`factory / teammate`) is the machine loop leg that
  produced the REQUEST_CHANGES review — re-armed automatically once the threads
  are resolved. The `Quality gate` aggregate is reddened by the `guards` leg
  fixed here; job logs for the other legs show green (review reproduction).
- Thread-level replies for all four inline threads are in
  `outputs/review_replies.json`. The two top-level `no-id` comments are the
  review summary (addressed by this response) and the gh-807 verdict record
  ("do not edit or reply").

## Approach

TDD for every change — each new test was run RED against the pre-fix code and
GREEN after:

1. **CRAP fix (split-by-concern, AGENTS.md pattern):** extracted the whole
   `skill == null` resolution block from `_runSkillCommand` into
   `Future<Skill?> _resolveSkillMiss(String name)` (toggled-off report →
   cold-resolve via `_coldResolveSkill` → exact `unknown skill` wording, AC4
   untouched). `_runSkillCommand` is now
   `skill ??= await _resolveSkillMiss(name); if (skill == null) return;`.
2. **Disabled-message dedup:** one `_reportDisabledSkill(Skill)` helper renders
   the report for both the indexed and the cold-resolve path — identical
   `skill <name> is disabled (<scope>) — enable with /skills on <name>` wording.
3. **Rescan retry (suggestion):** `_checkSkillsFreshness` no longer
   pre-assigns `_skillRootsFingerprint`; the baseline updates only on success
   (`_noteSkillScan`'s recompute), a failed rescan keeps the old baseline so
   the next turn retries, and the I5 at-most-one-rescan guarantee is held by an
   explicit `_rescanning` latch instead. New IT-7 test (`_CountingEnv` gains a
   `throwOnReadTextFile` fixture): dying body read mid-rescan → last good index
   + one warning; after healing, the next turn rescans and picks the skill up
   (verified RED pre-fix: never retried).
4. **Frontmatter tolerance (suggestion):** `frontmatterWellFormed` accepts
   `loadYaml == null` (empty/comment-only fence = well-formed "no metadata",
   directory-fallback name + first-body-line description — pre-gh-1440
   behavior). Unclosed fences, unparseable yaml and non-map yaml still skip
   with the warn-once note (AC6/E-1 unchanged). RED tests first in
   `test/utils/frontmatter_parser_test.dart` + a `discoverSkills`-level test in
   `test/skills/skills_test.dart`.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/skill_commands.dart` — `_resolveSkillMiss` + `_reportDisabledSkill`
  helpers; `_runSkillCommand` slimmed; `_checkSkillsFreshness` success-only
  baseline + `_rescanning` latch.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — `_rescanning` field.
- `lib/src/utils/frontmatter_parser.dart` — `frontmatterWellFormed` accepts
  empty/comment-only yaml fences (doc comment updated).
- `test/cli/skills_freshness_cli_test.dart` — IT-7 rescan-retry test;
  `_CountingEnv.throwOnReadTextFile` fixture.
- `test/utils/frontmatter_parser_test.dart` — `frontmatterWellFormed` group
  (7 cases).
- `test/skills/skills_test.dart` — empty-fence discovery test (REG-1 behavior).

## Test Coverage

- `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (per-PR CI suite, with coverage) —
  **10102 passed, 0 failed, 10 skipped** ✅ (standing platform skips:
  macOS `sandbox-exec` live legs + the documented giant-transcript stall skip)
- **CRAP ratchet reproduced locally** with the same input as CI (`crap4dart
  analyze` over merged-suite lcov incl. the jsr delegate trio):
  **Max CRAP: 12.00 — OK**; `_runSkillCommand` **15.45 → 7.31** (CC 13 → 7),
  `_resolveSkillMiss` 5.03, `_checkSkillsFreshness` 7.00 (100% cov),
  `_reportDisabledSkill` 2.00 (100% cov).
- `crap4dart check --baseline` — 3 passed, 1 warned (the pre-existing
  Type-2 duplication soft-warning window; never fails a build) ✅
- `crap4dart check --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc` — PASS ✅
- Diff coverage ratchet: **91.04%** of changed lib lines (min 80) ✅
  (`skill_commands.dart` 97.2%, `frontmatter_parser.dart` 100%)
- PTY suites over the refactored paths: `skills_freshness_pty_test` ✅,
  `skills_consent_pty_test` (4) ✅, `herdr_skills_pty_test` ✅ (REG-4 + #818)
- Focused suites: `test/skills/` 153 ✅, `frontmatter_parser_test` 12 ✅,
  `skills_freshness_cli_test` 10 ✅, `skills_builtin_cli_test` 18 ✅,
  `dart analyze` clean (one pre-existing info lint).
- All fixes are on `ai/gh-1440` (HEAD `db28f1e74`, pushed; includes the
